name: SAS-Bench
description:
SAS-Bench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Short Answer Scoring with Large Language Models
	

Dataset | 中文 | Paper | Code

	
		
		🔍 Overview
	

SAS-Bench represents the first specialized benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on Short Answer Scoring (SAS) tasks. Utilizing authentic questions from China's National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/aleversn/SAS-Bench.
evaluation_method: correlation with human scores / agreement metrics (e.g., Pearson/Spearman, QWK) and error measures
general_score_metric: Pearson correlation with human scores (primary reported agreement metric)
typical_sota_score: varies by prompt and subject; top LLMs often report Pearson r roughly between 0.7 and 0.95 (dataset- and task-dependent)
reputation: An emerging, specialized benchmark for assessing LLMs on short-answer grading (Gaokao questions); gaining interest for educational-evaluation research but not yet a broadly established standard.
